title: 第4章 传功授诀
content_zh:
一个奇特的空间里，陆云身体轻轻的飘浮在半空中。四周无数的星云，闪烁着五光十色的光芒，十分美丽，十分神秘。让人有一种进入虚幻的感觉，那感觉是如此的不真实，如此的让人难以相信。

陆云静静的等待着先祖为他，补足那先天残缺的一魂一魄，心里一片空明，什么也不想。这时，他如果睁开眼睛的话，就会发现，四周的星云开始发生改变了。只见无数五光十色的星云，突然急速的围着他旋转起来，在他身边形成一团七彩的星云，慢慢的化为细微的真气，流入他的身体。不远处，两团发光的奇异星云，正各自散发着十分美丽的光华，慢慢的向着陆云靠近。

仔细一看，那两团奇异的星团，竟然是一团七彩色的光芒，与一团乌黑发亮的星云，各自变幻着不同的形状。随着陆云四周的星云，飞速的进入陆云的身体，那团黑色的星云突然发出一道奇黑无比，闪着乌光的光柱，瞬间笼罩住陆云，顿时半空中，一把三寸长的古朴小刀，露出了本来面目。只见那把小刀三寸长，刀柄与刀身浑圆一体，看不出是什么东西炼制而成。刀身上刻着无数的咒语，闪动着奇异的黑色光芒。随着时间的过去，那小刀上的无数咒语，慢慢的在半空中出现，形成无数奇特的符号，每一道都印在陆云身上，慢慢的被他吸入身体。

四周的星云越来越密集，无限大的空间里，充满了取之不尽的天地灵气，正在飞速的向着陆云的身体里挤去。陆云全身放松，身体就像一个大的容器，正在不停的接收那些灵气，将它们据为己有，疯狂的转化成自己的功力。这时候，只见半空中的那把古朴小刀，瞬间发出璀璨的光华，牢牢的笼罩住陆云的身体。四周密集的星云瞬间就淡薄了下去，显然是瞬间就被陆云吸收进了身体。那小刀突然出现在陆云头顶，刀身发出无比耀眼的光芒，慢慢的向着陆云的头顶百汇穴逼近，似乎想从那里进入他的身体。

小刀突然一降，瞬间插入陆云的头顶，这一刻，四周的星云瞬间就加快了十倍的速度，疯狂的涌入陆云的身体。但仅仅一下，那小刀又升起一寸，离开了陆云的头顶，顿时四周的星云又密集起来。时间慢慢过去，陆云身上正发生着天翻地覆的变化，那把小刀一连七次插入陆云头顶。每一次插入他的头顶百汇穴，陆云吸收四周灵气的速度就会爆增，瞬间就增加十倍，使得体内的灵气越来越多。

一直等到第七次，那把小刀才慢慢的消失在陆云的头顶，被他吸入了身体。这时起，陆云吸收灵气的速度就马上大增，瞬间就吸收了无数的灵气进入身体，并快速的转化成为自己的功力，增进自己的修为。等陆云吸收了那把小刀后，另一团七彩色的星云马上就靠近陆云，瞬间发出一团七彩色的光柱，将陆云的身体罩住，无数的七彩色咒语，幻化成各式各样的图形与符号，快速的被陆云吸入体内，转化成了他的真气。

半空中，一把闪着七彩色光芒的三寸小剑，不停的旋转着。四周的七彩色星云成一道光柱，快速的被陆云吸入身体，随着陆云吸收的灵气越来越多，那把七彩色的小剑光芒越来越弱，最后慢慢的化为一道七彩霞光，从陆云的头顶百汇穴进入了他的身体。顿时，陆云全身爆发出一道七彩色的璀璨光芒，瞬间就照亮了整个空间，光芒之甚，就宛如是这个空间中的一颗璀璨明星，将陆云整个人牢牢的抱在里面，直到过了好一会，那七彩霞光才突然消失了。这时候，四周的星云已经慢慢的浅薄了，陆云身边的星云已经被他吸收了大半，空间的灵气被他整整的吸取了将近一半，这是十分惊人的。

陆云心无杂念，静静的立在半空，身体慢慢的出现了异状。只见他四周慢慢的出现了五色光芒，那光芒之强盛，比起先前至少强大了数倍。五色光华流转不息，交替出现，正是他所学的五种上乘法诀。随着五色光华的出现，紧接着，陆云身体上又闪现无数的咒语，无数黑色的奇怪图形纷纷出现，分列四周，牢牢的护住陆云的身体。时间慢慢过去，最后，陆云身上又爆发出一道璀璨无比的七彩色光芒，瞬间照亮了整个空间，那股气势十分强大，宛如君临天地。

七彩色光芒之后，陆云的身体突然一分为三，紧接着又一分为七，无数道人影在半空交错重叠，就宛如灵魂出窍，瞬间出现无数个相同的陆云。半空中的无数人影纵横交错，每一道人影都闪动着不同的光芒，代表着不同的性质。这十条人影中，其中最耀眼的，是一道七彩人影与一道黑亮人影。那正是由灭神剑化作的一魂，与灭魂刀化作的一魄，都带着明显的色彩，与其他的几道人影不同。每一道人影四周，都汇聚着不同色彩的星云，正飞速的被陆云的身体吸取着。

人影幻化，瞬间十条人影又合而为一，慢慢的出现了陆云的本体。这时候，陆云的身体已经不在吸收四周的灵气，陆云也慢慢的睁开眼睛。陆云仔细的查看了一下自己的身体状况，顿时吓了他一跳，他发觉自己的修为比开始增强了七倍，真是不可思议，太神奇了。

陆云心里正自惊奇，那声音有响起：“终于算是完成了，一切顺利。你现在因为灭魂刀与灭神剑的缘故，瞬间吸取了整个空间一半的灵气，使得你的修为大为进步，一下跨越了两个境界，这是世间绝无仅有的事情。修真之途，分为筑基，祭符，驭物，炼器，元化，聚灵，元婴，还虚，不灭，归仙十个层次。一般人从筑基到祭符需要五年时间，从祭符到驭物要十年，要达到炼器的话，一般没有二三十年是没有希望的，除非是得天之巧的人。

而你现在已到了聚灵的境界，这是十分难得的，继续努力，会有大成的一天的。那灭魂刀与灭神剑的修炼之法，我都已经印在了你的脑海，将来你好好的修炼，自然妙用无方。现在我再传你‘天地无极’，然后你就一个人在这里慢慢的修炼。这‘天地无极’分为九层，从第五层‘万元归一’开始，第六层‘无限延伸’、第七层‘天地同春’、第八层‘所向无匹’、第九层‘随心所欲’，一层比一层难练，你需要有坚强的毅力，才有大成的机会。等你到把‘天地无极’炼到第六层‘无限延伸’的境界时，就可以离开了。以你现在的情况，也最多只能修炼到那个阶段而已。

世间一切讲究因缘，我们之间也仅仅有这一段缘，希望你好好珍惜。以后如何就看你自己的了，作为陆家的子孙，你要勇敢的面对一切，与天一拼，不要轻言放弃。现在你静下心来，我传你‘天地无极’的法诀，这套法诀霸道之极，将来你就会明白的，注意了。”说完，陆云脑海中，顿时浮现出无数的法诀，深深的印在他的脑海里。没多久，陆云就已经全部铭刻在心，永远无法忘记了。

等陆云记住后，那声音道：“浩瀚乾坤，天地无极，功成之日，随心所欲。缘也，命也，一切虚幻，皆为定也。努力吧，陆家后世中的唯一最传奇的子孙。从此一切只能靠你自己了，我能为你做的仅仅这些了。当你离开这里时，外面那个石棺就将毁灭，一切阵法都将破灭，天龙灵脉也将在不久之后慢慢消失，一切皆是注定，你无需去在意。洞外的三头灵蛇你要小心，此物神异非常，寿命未尽，现在你还不宜杀它，将来自有结局。珍惜在这里的每一刻，好好把握时机，告别了。”说完那声音慢慢消失了。

陆云四周看了一阵，大声道：“先祖，你还在吗，回答我，你在吗？”声音显得很空旷，可惜没有回音，看来那先祖的意念已经离开了。陆云微微轻叹一声，自己还有许多不解的事情，没有来得及问，可惜他就离开了。看了四周一眼，陆云慢慢平静下来，还是好好练功吧，这里可是天地灵气所集的地方，一定要抓紧时间，希望能够快速提升自己的修为，那样才不负先祖的厚望，才有与天争抗的本领。

时间就在无声中走过，陆云一个人就在这特殊的空间里，用心的修炼他的“天地无极”。没有时间限制，他一个人整天整夜，不分昼夜的修炼着。时间在流逝，修为在提升，他的命运也在改变着。不仅仅改变他自己，也同时改变着很多人。只是这一刻的他，不明白罢了。

山中一日，世上一年。陆云在那充满灵气的空间里，一直修炼到他的“天地无极”进入了第六层境界“无限延伸”时，才停止。陆云又试了几次，可惜正如先祖所言一样，他竟然真的只修炼到第六层，就无法精进了。陆云心知是离开的时候，在这里也不知道多久，除了先祖所传的“天地无极”外，师傅所传的五样法诀他都有了长足的长进，同时也对体内的灭魂刀与灭神剑有了许多了解。也该是离去的时候了，不是吗？

看了一眼四周已经显得稀少的灵气，陆云淡然一笑，自己的修为已经突破了元婴之界，进入了还虚境界，这是极为惊人的。以陆云现在的修为，在天下来说都是相当少见的了。微微抬头，看着上方，陆云淡然一笑，头顶瞬间发出一道七彩光芒，直破天宇，灭神剑顿时出现在他的头顶，瞬间就击破了先祖所创造的这个空间之门，也就是那道石棺盖子。陆云身体瞬间上升，一下就出现在了那个大洞中。看了一眼地上的石棺盖子，陆云虽然明白这个空间就将毁灭，却还是忍不住用力将它关上，然后看了一眼四周，身体化着一道青光，瞬间消失了人影。

就在陆云离开后，不久那石棺突然一声巨响，顿时爆炸了。一股强大的灵气如洪水般，瞬间从那里射出，慢慢的消失在了天地间。龙气已泄，灵脉将竭，魔门初始，大劫已临！

西蜀秦川，苍风岭下，一个淡蓝色的身影出现在一个小山村口。这人二十一二岁，英俊不凡，脸上带着三分笑容，显得格外亲切。双目清澈如水，如一道透心的明珠，异常的吸引人。陆云慢慢的向着家门口走去，这一次他是专门回来看望父母亲，并告诉父母亲，自己已经取回了先祖留下的宝物，也治愈了自己的病，好叫父母放心。等见过父母后，陆云打算再去看望一下师傅，然后就去那易园看看，有机会的话，就在那里修炼，为自己找个好的依靠。

一走近门口，陆云就见到母亲正站在门口看着自己，那慈爱的眼中，满是爱意。陆云道：“娘，云儿回来了。爹呢，他在吗？”

张华凤看着儿子，眼中满是惊喜，轻声道：“你爹在屋里，快进来，娘好好看看你。你这一去就是半年，也不知道你过得好不好，娘真是不放心。”

陆云轻轻扶住娘亲的手，慢慢的走进屋里。这时候父亲已经闻声出来了，一见陆云也是高兴无比。三人坐下后，父亲问道：“云儿，这一次可找到先祖留下宝藏的地方了吗？有没有什么收获，快说给我们听听。”父亲显得很急切，神情十分关心。

陆云笑道：“爹娘放心，云儿已经找到了先祖留下的宝物，同时云儿的病也治愈了，你们就放心好了。这一次回来，是想看望你们，同时我决定在看望了师傅后，就到易园去多学点东西，爹娘在这里要好生保重身体，不用为我担心。我现在一身绝技在身，没有什么可以伤害到我的，你们放心吧。”

父亲陆文宇与母亲张华凤闻言，都是一脸的高兴，显得开心极了。父亲道：“病好了就太好了，真是太好了，真是上天保佑啊，我儿终于摆脱了病魔缠身，谢谢你上苍。”

张华凤在一旁高兴得双眼落泪，神情异常激动，语气有些零乱的道：“真好，我儿的病好了，好了，好了，多高兴的事情，多开心的事情，真是太高兴了。”一边说着，一边落泪，那情景可以看出。这么多年了，为了儿子的病，这位作母亲的，付出了多少的辛酸与泪水，今天儿子病好了，她是多么的高兴，泪下如雨啊！

陆云看着父母，眼中满是不舍，忍不住轻声安慰道：“今天是个高兴的日子，我们应该庆祝一下，一家人好好的吃顿团圆饭，为这件事情庆祝，为这件事情高兴。”

陆文宇闻言，忙赞同道：“对，对，快别哭了，应该高兴一些，我们这就去准备。”说完起身，忙拉着妻子去准备去了。

一顿团圆饭，吃得很慢，三人都脸带笑容，显得很高兴。对于陆云出外修炼的事情，陆文宇与妻子张华凤都没有阻止，他们都明白，儿子这一生注定了不会平凡的过一生，所以除了有些不舍外，没有过多的阻拦。

陆文宇看着高大英俊的儿子，眼中露出一丝父爱与不舍，轻声道：“云儿，你这一生注定了不会平凡，我和你娘都明白，所以我们不会阻止你的决定。只是此去千万小心，虽然你有一身本领，但天下之大，无奇不有，人外有人，天外有天，你要切记小心，不可过于逞强。只要你平安一生，我和你娘就高兴了，明白吗？”

陆云沉声道：“爹，云儿明白，你放心吧。我会好好保护自己，不会轻易涉险。”

张华凤看着儿子，轻声道：“云儿你也不小了，将来要是看见喜欢的姑娘，记得好好珍惜，娘没有什么可盼的了，就只望你早点成亲，为我们陆家留下一条命脉。希望你能找到自己喜欢的姑娘，要是找到了，记得带回来让娘也高兴一下，记住别忘了。”

陆云闻言一愣，但很快就恢复过来，笑道：“娘放心好了，你看云儿这样子，像娶不到媳妇的人吗？将来找到心爱的姑娘，我会带回来让娘过目的，你放心吧。”

饭后，陆云在房屋四周布下了一个奇阵，为的是防止妖邪靠近。只见他在四周立了六块数尺大的石柱，每一个石柱都按照一定的方位排列。陆云在每一个石柱中，都输入了一道灵力，可以保持一直不散，一般的妖邪是根本无法靠近的，就是修真之人，只要心存恶念，一靠近这奇阵，也会被阻挡在外面。

当陆云将家里的一切都安顿好后，他便离开的家门，前往看望师傅去了。来到师傅住的山洞，远远的就见到师傅站在那里，似乎算准了自己今天会来。

怪人看着陆云，眼中出一丝惊讶，开口道：“想不到几个月不见，你竟然一连跨过了三个境界，到了还虚的初级了，真是不可思议，恐怕天下都找不出第二个。一般的修真之人，想从炼器阶段，提升到还虚阶段，没有两子甲子的时间，那是绝对不可能的。就算天姿再好的天才，也得三十年时间，你真是太令我吃惊了。”

陆云笑道：“徒儿这点本事，还不都是师傅教的。所谓名师出高徒吗，功劳都应该算是师傅你老人家的。不知道师傅你现在修炼到了那个阶段了，竟然一眼就看出了我的修为，真是让我有些吃惊啊！师傅能告诉我吗？本来我还在想，去易园可以隐藏自己的身份，想不到师傅一眼就看出来了，看样子到了易园，也是逃不过别人的眼睛的。”

怪人瞪了他一眼，道：“不要不知足，其实以你现在这等修为，世间能看透的人不多。我能看出来，那是因为我是你师傅，别人恐怕就不容易看出了。还有就是你在我面前，并没有刻意的隐藏自己，所以我能看透你的修为，如果你在别人面前，只要注意隐藏自己的气息，那么天下绝对没有几人可以看出你的修为。至于师傅我现在修炼到了什么境界，告诉你也无妨，为师在两百年前，就已经修炼到了归仙之界，现在吗，你自己去想吧。”

陆云闻言脸色大变，一脸惊骇的道：“这么说来，师傅已经算得上是神仙之流了，可为什么还留在这凡世呢？”这一点陆云不解，常人修真都为了成仙，一但修炼到归仙境界，就可以得道成仙，羽化升天。可为什么师傅修炼到了那个境界，却依然留在这个尘世间呢？奇怪。

怪人看了他一眼，淡淡的道：“这一点将来你自然会明白，现在不要多问。这一次你回来，是专门来看我的了？”

陆云笑道：“弟子正是专程来看望师傅你老人家的，我已经打算到易园去，到那里去学习一点易园的本领，顺便找个好的依靠，继续修炼。这一次回来，也是想问一问，弟子现在修为大增，师傅可还有什么旷世绝学，以前没有教给弟子的，现在也可以补上啊。”说完笑笑，那样子显得有几分邪异。

怪人瞪了他一眼道：“什么本事都传你了，你现在还是用心苦练吧。别人修真，只学一门，为的是艺在精而不在博，可以加快速度，可你一人学全了我所有的本领，一身集五派至高无上的玄功于一体，还不满足，真是修真之人的大忌。修真之人，切记不能有贪念，不然修炼之时，十有八九都要走火入魔，最后落得不得善终。你现在要修炼的，就是如何隐藏自己的气息，不让别人看出你的底细，那才是关键的。对于这个，我倒是可以指点你一些，你要有空可以留下三天，三天后再离开，保证让你收获不小。”

逆远笑道：“那就先谢过师傅，我就再跟师傅多学几天本事，免得将来为你老人家丢人现眼，你说是不是呢？”说完英俊的脸上，含着一丝淡然的微笑，十分的诱人。

于是，陆云又在这里呆了三天。三天的时间里，怪人教了他不少小巧的技巧，使得他的修为又有了不小的进步，在外表上，更是让人无法察觉了。三天的成果，十分明显。

三天的时间很短，怪人看着陆云，眼中露出一丝满意的神色，轻笑道：“不错，你的进步真是惊人，现在可以安心的放你出去闯天下了。以你现在的修为，恐怕在修真界也算得上是位高手了，以后切记注意隐藏自己的实力，那是修真界里十分难以做到的事情。因为修真界里的人，也爱名利，最喜欢出风头，展现自己的实力。往往那些人，总是被别人一眼就看穿了，对别人难以造成一点威胁。属于蠢才型的人物，而翩翩那种人就是最多的，特别是少年。那是一大禁忌，你要切记。你打算现在离开，还是明天？”

陆云笑道：“我打算回家住一晚，明天出发，前往易园，开始一段新的生活。”说完微微的看着苍天，似乎在对着上苍说出了自己的决定。

陆云，一个先天缺少一魂一魄的少年，在他的生命中，两次遇上奇遇，从而改变了他的一生。这个被上天惩罚的少年，今后的路，会顺利，还是充满了坎坷呢？或许那要看上天，是否继续惩罚他了。

In a strange space, Lu Yun's body floated gently in mid-air. There were countless nebulae around, shining with five lights and ten colors. They were very beautiful and mysterious. There is a feeling of entering the illusion, that feeling is so unreal, so unbelievable.

Lu Yun quietly waited for the ancestor to make up for him, replenishing the soul and soul of the innate incomplete, his heart was empty and he didn't want anything. At this time, if he opened his eyes, he would find that the surrounding nebula began to change. I saw countless nebulae of five lights and ten colors, suddenly revolving rapidly around him, forming a cluster of colorful nebulae around him, slowly turning into a subtle true qi and flowing into his body. Not far away, the two glowing strange nebulae were each radiating a very beautiful splendor, slowly approaching the landing cloud.

Looking closely, the two strange star clusters turned out to be a cluster of seven-colored lights, and a black and shiny nebula, each with a different shape. With the nebula around Lu Yun, rapidly entering the body of Lu Yun, the black nebula suddenly emitted a strange black, shining dark light pillar, instantly enveloping Lu Yun. Suddenly, in mid-air, a simple knife three inches long revealed its original face. I saw that the knife was three inches long, and the handle and the blade were completely integrated. I could not see what it was made of. Countless spells were engraved on the blade, and a strange black light flashed. With the passage of time, countless spells on that knife slowly appeared in mid-air, forming countless strange symbols. Each one was printed on Lu Yun and slowly sucked into his body by him.

The surrounding nebulae are getting denser and denser, and the infinite space is full of inexhaustible aura of heaven and earth, and is squeezing rapidly into the body of the landing cloud. Lu Yun relaxed his whole body. His body was like a big container. He was constantly receiving those aura, taking them for his own, and frantically transforming them into his own power. At this moment, he saw the simple knife in the middle of the sky, which instantly emitted a brilliant splendor and firmly enveloped Lu Yun's body. The dense nebula around them faded down in an instant, apparently absorbed into Lu Yun's body in an instant. The knife suddenly appeared above Lu Yun's head, and the blade shone with incomparable dazzling light. It slowly approached the Baihui Cave on the top of the landing cloud, and seemed to want to enter his body from there.

The knife suddenly fell and instantly inserted itself above Lu Yun's head. At this moment, the surrounding nebula instantly accelerated by ten times, and frantically poured into Lu Yun's body. But just for a moment, the knife rose an inch and left the top of Lu Yun's head. Suddenly, the nebula around him became dense again. Slowly, time passed, and Lu Yun's body was undergoing earth-shaking changes. The knife was inserted into Lu Yun's head seven times in a row. Every time he inserted Baihui Cave above his head, Lu Yun's speed of absorbing the aura around him would explode, increasing tenfold in an instant, making the aura in his body more and more.

Until the seventh time, the knife slowly disappeared above Lu Yun's head and was sucked into his body by him. At this time, Lu Yun's speed of absorbing aura increased dramatically, and he instantly absorbed countless aura into his body and quickly transformed it into his own power to improve his cultivation. After Lu Yun absorbed the knife, another group of seven-colored nebulae immediately approached Lu Yun and instantly emitted a group of seven-colored light pillars, covering Lu Yun's body. Countless seven-colored spells transformed into various shapes and symbols. They were quickly sucked into Lu Yun's body and transformed into his true Qi.

In the middle of the air, a three-inch small sword shining with seven colors of light was constantly spinning. The seven-colored nebula around him became a pillar of light, which was quickly sucked into his body by Lu Yun. As Lu Yun absorbed more and more aura, the light of the seven-colored sword became weaker and weaker, and finally slowly transformed into a seven-colored haze light, which entered his body from the top of Lu Yun's head. Suddenly, Lu Yun's whole body exploded with a bright light of seven colors, instantly illuminating the entire space. The light was even more like a bright star in this space, holding Lu Yun's whole person firmly in it until after a while, the seven-colored glow suddenly disappeared. At this time, the surrounding nebulae were already slowly shallow. The nebulae around Lu Yun had been absorbed by him for most of the time, and the aura of space had been absorbed by him by nearly half, which was very amazing.

Lu Yun's mind was unconcerned, and he stood quietly in the air. Slowly, something abnormal appeared in his body. The five colors of light appeared slowly around him. The light was at least several times stronger than before. The five-colored splendor was constantly flowing, and it appeared alternately. It was precisely the five superior techniques he had learned. With the emergence of the five-colored splendor, Lu Yun's body flashed countless spells, and countless strange black figures appeared, arranged around, firmly protecting Lu Yun's body. The time slowly passed. Finally, a brilliant seven-colored light burst out on Lu Yun's body, instantly illuminating the entire space. That momentum was very powerful, like a monarch landing in heaven and earth.

After the seven-colored light, Lu Yun's body suddenly split into three, and then into seven. Countless human figures overlapped in mid-air, just like a soul out of the pupil, countless identical Lu Yun appeared in an instant. Countless figures crisscrossed the mid-air. Each figure flashed a different light, representing a different nature. Of these ten figures, the most dazzling was a colorful figure and a black shining figure. It was a soul transformed by the Extinguishing Sword, and a soul transformed by the Extinguishing Blade, all with obvious colors, which was different from several other human figures. Around each figure, nebulae of different colors were gathered. They were being absorbed by Lu Yun's body at a rapid pace.

The human shadow transformed into an illusion, and in an instant, the ten human shadows merged into one again. Slowly, Lu Yun's body appeared. At this time, Lu Yun's body was no longer absorbing the spiritual energy around him. Lu Yun also slowly opened his eyes. Lu Yun took a closer look at his physical condition and immediately frightened him. He found that his cultivation ratio began to increase seven times. It was incredible. It was amazing.

Lu Yun was surprised in his heart, and the voice sounded, "At last, it is finally completed, and everything is going well. Because of the exterminating blade and exterminating legendary sword, you have instantly absorbed half of the aura of the entire space, making your cultivation greatly improved. Crossing the two realms at once, this is the only thing in the world. The path of cultivation is divided into building foundations, sacrificial talismans, controlling objects, refining tools, yuan transformation, gathering spirits, nascent souls, returning to the void, immortality, and returning to the immortal in ten levels. It takes five years for the average person to build a foundation to reach the sacrificial talisman, and ten years from the sacrificial talisman to the control object. If you want to reach the refining tool, there is usually no hope for 20 or 30 years, unless it is a person who is talented.

And now that you have reached the realm of gathering spirits, this is very rare. Continue to work hard and you will have a great day. The cultivation techniques of the Extinguishing Soul Blade and the Extinguishing Divine Sword are already imprinted in your mind. You will cultivate well in the future, and naturally there is no way to use them. Now I will pass on your ‘boundless heaven and earth’, and then you will slowly cultivate here alone. This‘ heaven and earth infinity ’is divided into nine layers. Starting from the fifth layer‘ 10,000 yuan unification ’, the sixth layer‘ infinite extension ’, the seventh layer‘ heaven and earth spring ’, the eighth layer‘ incomparable ', and the ninth layer’ whatever you want ‘. It is more difficult to practice on one layer than another. You need to have strong perseverance to have a chance to achieve great success. When you refine‘ Heaven and Earth Infinity ’to the sixth level of’ Infinite Extension ’, you can leave. In your current situation, you can only cultivate up to that stage.

Everything in the world pays attention to causation, and there is only this fate between us, I hope you cherish it. Look at yourself in the future. As a descendant of the Lu family, you have to face everything bravely, fight with the sky, and don't give up lightly. Now you calm down, I will pass on your ‘heaven and earth limitless’ spell. This set of spells is the ultimate in hegemony, you will understand in the future, pay attention. "After that, Lu Yun's mind suddenly revealed countless magic tricks, which were deeply imprinted in his mind. Before long, Lu Yun was already engraved in his heart and could never forget it.

After Lu Yun remembered, the voice said, "The vastness of the universe, the limitlessness of the heavens and the earth, the day of success, as much as you want. Fate, fate, and all illusions are determined. Work hard, the single most legendary descendant of the Lu family. From now on, everything is on your own, that's all I can do for you. When you leave here, the sarcophagus outside will be destroyed, all formations will be destroyed, and the Heavenly Dragon's spiritual veins will slowly disappear soon. Everything is destined, so you don't have to worry about it. The three-headed spirit snake outside the cave should be careful. This creature is very strange and has not yet reached the end of its life. You should not kill it now, it will come to an end. Cherish every moment here, seize the opportunity, and say goodbye." The voice slowly disappeared.

Lu Yun looked around for a while and said loudly, "Ancestor, are you still there? Answer me, are you there? The voice seemed empty, but unfortunately there was no response. It seemed that the ancestor's thoughts had left. Lu Yun sighed slightly. He still had a lot of things to puzzle about. He didn't have time to ask, but unfortunately, he left. After a glance around, Lu Yun slowly calmed down and practiced well. This is the place where the aura of heaven and earth gather. We must hurry up and hope to quickly improve our cultivation, so that we can live up to the high expectations of our ancestors and have the ability to fight against the sky.

Time passed silently, and Lu Yun was alone in this special space, intent on cultivating his "Limitless Heaven and Earth". There was no time limit, he cultivated all day and all night by himself. Time was passing, his cultivation was improving, and his destiny was changing. Not only did he change himself, but he also changed many people at the same time. It's just that at this moment, he just doesn't understand.

A day in the mountains, a year in the world. In that aura-filled space, Lu Yun did not stop until his "Heaven and Earth Infinity" cultivation entered the "Infinite Extension" of the sixth level realm. Lu Yun tried again a few times. Unfortunately, as the ancestors said, he actually only cultivated to the sixth level, so he could not improve. Lu Yun's heart knew that when he left, he did not know how long he was here. In addition to the "infinity of heaven and earth" handed down by his ancestors, he had made great strides in the five magic secrets passed down by his master, and at the same time had a lot of understanding of the soul exterminating blades and exterminating legendary swords in his body. It's time to leave, isn't it?

Looking at the aura that was already scarce around, Lu Yun smiled indifferently. His cultivation had broken through the realm of Nascent Souls and entered the realm of returning to the void, which was extremely amazing. Lu Yun's current cultivation is quite rare under the heavens. Looking up slightly, Lu Yun smiled faintly. A colorful light shone from the top of his head, breaking through the sky. The Extinction Sword appeared on top of his head and instantly broke the door of the space created by his ancestors, that is, the sarcophagus cover. Lu Yun's body rose in an instant and appeared in that big hole. Looking at the sarcophagus lid on the ground, although Lu Yun understood that this space would be destroyed, he could not help but forcefully close it. Then he glanced around, his body turned into a green light, and instantly disappeared.

Just after Lu Yun left, the sarcophagus suddenly exploded with a loud noise. A powerful aura spewed out from there like a flood. It slowly disappeared into the heavens and the earth. Dragon Qi has been released, and the spiritual veins will be exhausted. At the beginning of the Demon Sect, the Great Tribulation has arrived!

Xishu Qinchuan, under the Cangfeng Mountains, a pale blue figure appeared at the entrance of a small mountain village. This person was twenty-one or twenty-two years old, handsome, with a three-point smile on his face, and looked extremely cordial. His eyes were as clear as water, like a clear pearl, unusually attractive. Lu Yun slowly walked towards the door of his home. This time, he specifically came back to visit his parents and told them that he had recovered the treasures left by his ancestors and also cured his own illness, so that his parents could rest assured. After meeting his parents, Lu Yun planned to visit the master again, and then go to the Yiyuan to see. If he had the chance, he would cultivate there and find a good support for himself.

As soon as he approached the door, Lu Yun saw his mother standing in the doorway looking at him. His loving eyes were full of love. Lu Yun said, "Mother, Yun 'er is back. Where's Dad? Is he here?"

Zhang Hua Feng looked at his son, his eyes full of surprises, and said softly, "Your father is in the house. Come in quickly. Mother, take a good look at you. You're going for half a year now. I don't know if you're doing well. Mom is really uneasy."

Lu Yun gently held his mother's hand and slowly walked into the room. At this time, his father had already heard it, and he was very happy to see Lu Yun. After the three of them sat down, the father asked, "Yun 'er, can you find the place where the ancestors left the treasure this time? Tell us if there is any harvest." My father seemed very anxious, and his expression was very concerned.

Lu Yun smiled, "Parents, rest assured that Yun 'er has found the treasure left by her ancestors. At the same time, Yun 'er's illness has also been cured, so you can rest assured. I came back this time to visit you. At the same time, I decided to go to Yiyuan to learn more after visiting the master. Parents here should take good care of their health and don't worry about me. I am now in my stunts. Nothing can hurt me. Don't worry."

His father Lu Wenyu and his mother Zhang Hua Feng were all happy when they heard the words. They looked very happy. Father said, "It's so good to be cured. It's so good. God bless you. My son finally got rid of the disease. Thank you for your help."

Zhang Huafeng shed tears in his eyes. His expression was unusually excited, and he said in a somewhat disordered tone: "It's so good, my son's illness is healed, okay, okay, what a happy thing, what a happy thing, it's really very happy." As he spoke, he burst into tears. The scene could be seen. For so many years, for the sake of her son's illness, this mother has paid a lot of bitterness and tears. Today, her son has recovered from his illness. How happy she is, and her tears are raining!

Lu Yun looked at his parents and his eyes were full of reluctance. He couldn't help but whisper comfortingly, "Today is a happy day. We should celebrate. The family should have a good reunion meal to celebrate this matter and be happy about this matter."

When Lu Wenyu heard that, he hurriedly agreed, "Yes, yes, don't cry, you should be happier, we'll go and prepare. After saying that, he got up and hurriedly dragged his wife to prepare.

A reunion meal, eating very slowly, the three of them smiled and looked very happy. Lu Wenyu and his wife Zhang Huafeng did not stop Lu Yun from going out to cultivate. They all understood that their son was destined not to live an ordinary life in this life, so except for some reluctance, there were not too many obstacles.

Lu Wenyu looked at his tall and handsome son, revealing a trace of fatherly love and reluctance in his eyes, and said softly, "Yun 'er, your life is destined to be unusual. Both you and I understand, so we will not stop your decision. Just be careful, although you have a skill, but the world is big, no wonder, there are people outside the world, there is a day outside the sky, you must be careful, do not be too aggressive. As long as you live in peace, your mother and I will be happy, understand?"

Lu Yun said in a deep voice, "Father, Yun 'er understands. Don't worry. I will protect myself well and will not get involved easily."

Zhang Hua Feng looked at his son and said softly, "Yun 'er is also not small. If you see a girl you like in the future, remember to cherish it well. There is nothing to look forward to. I just hope that you will get married soon and leave a lifeline for our Lu family. I hope you can find a girl you like. If you find one, remember to bring it back to make your mother happy, and don't forget."

Lu Yun was stunned when he heard the words, but soon recovered and smiled, "Ma'am, rest assured. Do you see Yun 'er like this, like someone who can't marry his daughter-in-law? In the future, I will find my beloved girl, and I will bring her back for her purpose. Don't worry."

After the meal, Lu Yun laid a strange formation around the house to prevent the demons from approaching. It was seen that he had erected six stone pillars of several feet in size around him, and each stone pillar was arranged in a certain orientation. Lu Yun entered a spiritual force in each stone pillar, which can remain unchanged. The general demons cannot be approached at all, that is, the cultivators. As long as the heart has evil thoughts, as soon as it approaches this strange formation, it will be blocked outside.

When Lu Yun settled everything in the family, he left the house and went to visit the master. Coming to the cave where the master lived, I saw the master standing there from a distance, and it seemed that I was going to come today.

The monster looked at Lu Yun in amazement and said, "I can't believe you haven't seen him in a few months. You've crossed three realms in a row. It's incredible that you've reached the junior level of returning to the void. I'm afraid the world can't find a second one. The ordinary cultivator wanted to ascend from the refining stage to the stage of returning void. Without the time of the two children, that was absolutely impossible. Even a good-looking genius would take 30 years, which is really surprising to me."

Lu Yun smiled, "The disciple's skills are not all taught by the master. The so-called famous master out of the high disciples, the credit should be counted as the master your old man's home. I don't know, Master, you have reached that stage of cultivation now. You actually recognized my cultivation at a glance, which really surprised me a little! Master, can you tell me? Originally, I was still thinking that going to Yiyuan could hide my identity. I didn't expect Master to see it at a glance. It seems that when I arrived at Yiyuan, I couldn't escape the eyes of others."

The monster stared at him and said, "Don't be dissatisfied. In fact, with your current cultivation, there are not many people in the world who can see through it. I can see it, that's because I'm your master, I'm afraid it's not easy for others to see it. There is also that you are not deliberately hiding yourself in front of me, so I can see through your cultivation. If you are in front of others, as long as you pay attention to hiding your breath, then absolutely few people in the world can see your cultivation. As for what level of master cultivation I have now, there is no harm in telling you. As a master, I have already cultivated to the realm of returning to the immortal two hundred years ago. Now, think about it for yourself."

Lu Yun's expression changed drastically and he said in horror, "In that case, Master is already a fairy, but why stay in this mortal world? Lu Yun was puzzled at this point. Ordinary cultivators were all cultivating to become immortals. Once they cultivated to the Immortal Returning Realm, they could become immortals and ascend to heaven. But why did the master cultivate to that realm, but still stay in this earthly world? Strange.

The strange man looked at him and said indifferently, "You will naturally understand this point in the future. Don't ask more questions now. Did you come back to visit me this time?"

Lu Yun smiled, "The disciple is on a special trip to visit your old master's house. I have already planned to go to Yiyuan, where I will learn a little of Yiyuan's skills, find a good support by the way, and continue to cultivate. When I came back this time, I also wanted to ask, the disciples are now greatly increased in their cultivation. Teacher, what else is there to learn? If you haven't taught your disciples before, you can make up for it now." After talking and laughing, it seemed a bit sinister.

The weirdo glared at him and said, "Anything you can do has been passed on to you. You'd better work hard now. Others cultivate, only learn one thing, in order to refine the art and not be in the bo, you can speed up, but you can learn all my abilities alone, a set of five schools of supreme profound art in one, not satisfied, really a cultivator's taboo. Cultivators, remember that there can be no covetousness, otherwise, when cultivating, ten out of eight or nine will go into the devil, and in the end, there will be no end to goodness. What you want to cultivate now is how to hide your breath and not let others see your details. That's the key. For this, I can point out some things to you. If you have time, you can stay for three days, and then leave after three days, so that you can gain a lot."

Reverse smiled and said, "Then thank Master first. I will learn more skills from Master for a few more days, so as not to embarrass your elderly family in the future. Don't you think so? After saying that, he had a faint smile on his handsome face, which was very seductive.

So, Lu Yun stayed here for another three days. Over the course of three days, the weirdo taught him a lot of small skills, which made his cultivation a lot of progress. On the outside, it was even more imperceptible. The results of three days were very obvious.

The three days were very short. The weirdo looked at Lu Yun with a look of satisfaction in his eyes and said with a gentle smile, "Yes, your progress is amazing. Now you can go out and break the world with peace of mind. With your current cultivation, I am afraid that you are also a master in the cultivation world. In the future, remember to hide your strength, which is very difficult to do in the cultivation world. Because people in the cultivation world, also love fame and fortune, most like to show off their strength. Often, those people are always seen through by others at a glance, and it is difficult for them to pose a little threat to others. People who belong to the idiot genius type, and the kind of person who is personally the most, especially teenagers. That's a big taboo, so keep that in mind. Are you going to leave now or tomorrow?"

Lu Yun smiled, "I plan to stay at home for one night. I will leave tomorrow and go to Yiyuan to start a new life. After saying that, he looked at the heavens slightly and seemed to say his decision to the heavens.

Lu Yun, a teenager who was born lacking one soul and one soul, encountered adventures twice in his life, which changed his life. This young man who was punished by heaven, the road ahead will go smoothly, or is it full of bumps? Perhaps it would depend on heaven if he continued to punish him.
